brief:
Alaa was forced to flee Gaza as the genocide unfolded, joining thousands displaced by the conflict. We Are Not Numbers reported that she remains determined to return to her homeland despite the devastation that drove her away.

Her resolve reflects the experience of many Palestinians who have lost homes and communities yet refuse to abandon their ties to Gaza. The ongoing displacement has separated families and shattered lives across the territory.
dek: The genocide forced my friend Alaa to leave Gaza. She is determined to return to her homeland.
title: Gazan woman displaced by genocide vows to return home
